field.label: Block type
field.help: Response returned for blocked queries: "zeroIp" answers with 0.0.0.0/::, "nxDomain" answers with NXDOMAIN, or enter a comma separated list of destination IP addresses (include both an IPv4 and an IPv6 to cover all query types) to point blocked names at your own "blocked" web server.

field.label: Block TTL
field.help: TTL returned for blocked queries, e.g. 6h.

field.label: List refresh period
field.help: Interval at which deny/allow lists are refreshed from their sources, e.g. 4h. Set to 0 to disable periodic refresh.

field.label: List loading strategy
field.help: How lists load at startup: blocking waits for all lists before serving (blocking active immediately), failOnError aborts startup if a list fails to load, fast serves immediately and loads lists in the background.

field.label: Max errors per source
field.help: Number of parse errors tolerated in a single list before it is treated as invalid. Use -1 to disable the limit.

field.label: Download timeout
field.help: Timeout for downloading each list URL. Increase for large lists or slow links, e.g. 60s.

field.label: Download attempts
field.help: Number of times to retry a failed list download.

field.label: Download cooldown
field.help: Wait time between failed download attempts.

field.label: Download write timeout
field.help: Timeout for writing a downloaded list to disk. Use 0 to disable.

field.label: Download read timeout
field.help: Timeout for reading the download body. Use 0 to disable.

field.label: Download header timeout
field.help: Timeout for reading response headers. Use -1 to disable.

field.label: Load concurrency
field.help: Maximum number of lists processed in parallel.
